claims_not_made: Exact preservation of every hair pixel
Equivalence to linear-HDR denoising with albedo/normal guides
observations: Sampling grain is visibly reduced in the gray background, white head/belly and dark coat.
Eye rims, pupils, nose highlights, smile line, dragon horn/wing contours and raised crown-scale shapes remain recognizable and aligned.
Short directional coat texture remains visible, especially on the dark arms and eye patches; subpixel hairs and some surface detail are softened.
The denoiser does not fix the underlying v1 solid forelock, inner-ear disks, stylized facial form or lighting; these require the separate v2 geometry/presentation changes.
scope: Visual comparison of the actual 1600px locally rendered input and its single color-only OIDN output; no new render or generation

validation.scope: Analytic PNG fixtures and mocked filter roundtrip; zero native denoising executions
